messages:
Sam: Heads-up: noticed p95 queue for /v1/embeddings spikes when mix of 1024-dim and 64-dim requests arrive. Small dims get stuck behind large batches.
Jess: yep, saw it in datadog. latency heatmap shows small-requests queueing ~120ms behind large ones. :frowning: 
Kai: is it routing or scheduler? runtime currently batches by token_count then by dim, so large dims dominate.
Sam: Routing policy currently uses route=default; can we fast-path tiny dims to a 'thin' route?
Ben: we have headers for hints: `x-embed-dim-hint`. but clients rarely set it.
Jess: telemetry shows ~18% of traffic would benefit if we had a dynamic sample-rate for preflight + fastpath. I can share query.
Sam: example:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Headers:
  x-embed-dim-hint: 64
  x-embed-priority: low|normal|high
Body: { "input": [...], "model":"rwd-embed-1" }
```
Carla: debating adding server-side dim-detection preflight adds ~1ms overhead. tradeoffs?
Kai: propose adaptive path: preflight only when request body bytes < 8KB and count < 32, else skip. telemetry config: sample_rate=0.1, emit: [fastpath_hit, fallback_reason]
Jess: want a dashboard widget: small-request ratio, fastpath hit rate, fastpath p95, fallback counts. also a per-tenant breakdown.
Sam: UX for console toggle: simple ON/OFF for fastpath, with canary % and required telemetry checkbox.
Ben: rollout plan: canary 5% tenant-weighted -> increase 25% -> metrics hold for 24h -> 100%.
deploy-bot: canary started on prod at 6570213520 :rocket:
Mike: note quotas: fastpath bypasses some batching quotas; need to ensure quota accounting stays consistent.
Jess: agreed — quota should still charge per-embedding-unit and be visible in per-route console.
Sam: next steps: Jess to craft dashboard panel PR, Kai to prototype preflight hook, Ben to add header parsing, rollout doc in GH. cc @Carla @Mike
